en.text: The global grains and oilseeds market over the past 30 days has been characterized by stable sentiment despite notable shifts in US crop planting intentions and USDA data revisions. US farmers are expected to increase soybean acreage in 2026 while reducing corn plantings, signaling a strategic pivot in crop focus. Concurrently, USDA's credibility faced scrutiny following significant downward revisions in US corn acreage, which has injected uncertainty but not immediate price volatility. Compared to the previous month, the volume of market-relevant events doubled, though overall market impact remained neutral. This environment suggests cautious positioning among traders, with attention on evolving US planting trends and data accuracy. For brokers and traders, monitoring USDA updates and planting intentions will be critical for anticipating supply-side shifts, while price levels remain steady without strong directional cues. Key facts highlight the evolving US crop landscape and stable global market conditions.
